title: Cross-Device Session Continuity Library
description: Library to seamlessly continue wallet sessions across devices (top non-trading product unlock)
problem_en: Wallet sessions don't persist across devices — switching mobile→desktop forces re-auth and loses transaction state. No standard XRPL session library exists despite this being identified as the top non-trading product unlock.
problem_fr: Les sessions wallet ne persistent pas entre appareils — passer de mobile à desktop force une ré-authentification et fait perdre l'état des transactions. Aucune librairie de session XRPL standard n'existe alors que c'est identifié comme le premier déblocage produit non-trading.

title: Institutional Multisig Wallet (Full UI)
description: Safe-equivalent for XRPL — full UI for institutional multisig
notes: Distinct from gap-01 (treasury platform) — kept separate
problem_en: XRPL supports multisig natively but there's no Safe-equivalent UI for institutional treasury teams. Manual coordination via raw transactions is unworkable for funds, DAOs, and corporations holding XRP.
problem_fr: XRPL supporte le multisig nativement mais aucun équivalent Safe n'existe en UI pour les équipes treasury institutionnelles. La coordination manuelle via transactions brutes est inutilisable pour des fonds, DAOs et entreprises détenant du XRP.

title: Smart Contract Wallet on EVM Sidechain
description: ERC-4337 wallet — table-stakes vs Base/Arbitrum
problem_en: XRPL EVM Sidechain lacks ERC-4337 account abstraction wallets. Without smart accounts (social recovery, gas sponsorship, batched txs), EVM Sidechain UX is years behind Base/Arbitrum where AA is table-stakes.
problem_fr: L'EVM Sidechain XRPL n'a aucun wallet ERC-4337 (account abstraction). Sans smart accounts (social recovery, gas sponsoring, batch tx), l'UX EVM Sidechain a des années de retard sur Base/Arbitrum où l'AA est table-stakes.

title: Unified Cross-Chain Wallet SDK
description: Single SDK supporting both XRPL native + EVM Sidechain
problem_en: Developers building cross-chain products on XRPL native + EVM Sidechain need two separate wallet integrations. No single SDK abstracts both chains' signing, accounts, and queries.
problem_fr: Les devs qui construisent des produits cross-chain XRPL natif + EVM Sidechain doivent intégrer deux wallets séparés. Aucun SDK unique n'abstrait le signing, les comptes et les requêtes des deux chaînes.

title: Treasury wallet B2B XRPL-native
description: Coinshift/Utopia Labs equivalent — B2B treasury platform (uses M-02 multisig as primitive)
notes: Added Phase 1 — distinct from M-02 (multisig) which is a primitive
problem_en: B2B treasury management (Coinshift/Utopia Labs-equivalent) doesn't exist on XRPL. Businesses holding XRP/RLUSD need workflows for invoicing, payroll, vendor payments, multisig approval, accounting export.
problem_fr: La gestion de treasury B2B (équivalent Coinshift / Utopia Labs) n'existe pas sur XRPL. Les entreprises détenant XRP/RLUSD ont besoin de workflows pour facturation, paie, paiements fournisseurs, approbation multisig, export comptable.

title: KYC reusable cross-app
description: User-facing identity passport — manage and reuse KYC credentials across XRPL apps
notes: Added Phase 1 — user-facing app distinct from M-07 (backend lib)
problem_en: Every XRPL app forces users to KYC again. Users hate repeating the same KYC across 10 apps. A reusable credential passport (XLS-70 DID) lets users KYC once and reuse everywhere.
problem_fr: Chaque app XRPL force ses utilisateurs à refaire un KYC. Les users détestent répéter le même KYC sur 10 apps. Un passeport credential réutilisable (XLS-70 DID) permettrait de faire son KYC une fois et de le réutiliser partout.

title: Hardware wallet integration for XRPL wallets
description: SDK/library enabling Ledger/Trezor hardware signing across XRPL wallets — currently zero support
notes: Added from Djason interview May 2026 — major institutional adoption blocker
problem_en: No XRPL wallet supports Ledger/Trezor hardware wallets natively. Serious holders can't use cold storage; institutions can't custody safely. Years behind Ethereum/Solana where HW wallet support is table-stakes. (Source: Djason interview, May 2026)
problem_fr: Aucun wallet XRPL ne supporte nativement Ledger/Trezor. Les détenteurs sérieux ne peuvent pas utiliser de cold storage ; les institutions ne peuvent pas custodier en sécurité. Des années de retard sur Ethereum/Solana où le support HW wallet est table-stakes. (Source : interview Djason, mai 2026)

title: DeFi-first consumer XRPL wallet
description: Consumer wallet with first-class DeFi UX (2-click yield access, visible positions, smooth onboarding) — Xaman-replacement
notes: Added from Djason interview — Xaman DeFi UX is broken
problem_en: Xaman (the main XRPL wallet) has poor DeFi UX — too many actions to access yield, DeFi positions are unfindable, consumer onboarding is inadequate. No XRPL wallet treats DeFi as a first-class feature. (Source: Djason interview)
problem_fr: Xaman (le wallet XRPL principal) a une UX DeFi médiocre — trop d'actions pour accéder au yield, les positions DeFi sont introuvables, l'onboarding consumer est inadapté. Aucun wallet XRPL ne traite la DeFi comme une fonctionnalité de premier rang. (Source : interview Djason)

title: XRPL DeFi position aggregator (DeBank-equivalent)
description: Cross-protocol dashboard aggregating user DeFi positions across AMM, lending, vaults on XRPL + EVM Sidechain
notes: Added from Djason interview — "Position DeFi introuvable" friction
problem_en: Users with DeFi positions across AMM, lending, vaults can't see them aggregated. Each protocol has its own UI. DeBank/Zapper serve EVM chains. XRPL needs equivalent to make DeFi positions visible and manageable. (Source: Djason interview)
problem_fr: Les users avec des positions DeFi réparties sur AMM, lending, vaults ne peuvent pas les voir agrégées. Chaque protocole a sa propre UI. DeBank/Zapper servent les chaînes EVM. XRPL a besoin d'un équivalent pour rendre les positions DeFi visibles et gérables. (Source : interview Djason)

title: Socials Onboarding for XRPL wallets (Google/Twitter/Apple login)
description: Wallet TOOL enabling social login onboarding (Google/Twitter/Apple/Discord) — Privy/Magic.link equivalent for XRPL, kills the seed-phrase friction for retail
notes: Added from Guillaume interview May 2026 — direct mass-market consumer wedge. Privy/Magic.link/Web3Auth dominate EVM, no XRPL equivalent.
problem_en: No XRPL wallet offers social login (Google/Twitter/Apple/Discord). Seed phrase + private key is a massive retail friction. EVM ecosystem solved this with Privy, Magic.link, Web3Auth — millions onboarded who never see a seed phrase. XRPL's lack of this primitive blocks any serious consumer mass-market push. (Source: Guillaume interview, May 2026)
problem_fr: Aucun wallet XRPL ne propose de social login (Google/Twitter/Apple/Discord). La seed phrase + clé privée est une friction retail massive. L'écosystème EVM a résolu ça avec Privy, Magic.link, Web3Auth — des millions onboardés sans jamais voir une seed phrase. L'absence de cette primitive sur XRPL bloque toute vraie ambition consumer mass-market. (Source : interview Guillaume, mai 2026)

title: Institutional Data Emission Adapter Library
description: ISIN/CFI/LEI/FIX/IFRS adapters — highest leverage
problem_en: Institutional systems require ISIN/CFI/LEI/FIX/IFRS data formats; XRPL emits its own format. Every institutional integration rebuilds this adapter from scratch — a massive duplicated cost across adopters.
problem_fr: Les systèmes institutionnels exigent les formats ISIN/CFI/LEI/FIX/IFRS ; XRPL émet son propre format. Chaque intégration institutionnelle reconstruit cet adaptateur de zéro — un coût massif dupliqué chez tous les adopteurs.

title: Stablecoin Accounting & Reconciliation Export
description: QuickBooks/Xero/IFRS-compatible export library — narrow scope (kept as BLOCK)
notes: Narrow lib — gap-10 is the broader APP that uses this
problem_en: Merchants accepting RLUSD/USDC need to reconcile transactions with QuickBooks/Xero. No export tool exists today, blocking merchant adoption since accountants reject unreadable blockchain data.
problem_fr: Les marchands acceptant RLUSD/USDC doivent réconcilier leurs transactions avec QuickBooks/Xero. Aucun outil d'export n'existe aujourd'hui, ce qui bloque l'adoption marchands car les comptables refusent la donnée blockchain illisible.

title: Multi-Flow Institutional Access Control Library
description: Permissioned Domains × Credentials for institutional flows
notes: Distinct from gap-04 (user-facing KYC app) — kept separate
problem_en: Institutional flows require complex access control combining Permissioned Domains + XLS-70 Credentials. Implementing this composition is error-prone and rebuilt per project — a library would unblock multiple downstream use cases.
problem_fr: Les flux institutionnels exigent un contrôle d'accès complexe combinant Permissioned Domains + XLS-70 Credentials. Implémenter cette composition est source d'erreurs et reconstruit à chaque projet — une librairie débloquerait plusieurs cas d'usage downstream.

title: On-chain accounting + reporting
description: Broader accounting/reporting platform (uses M-06 export lib + adds reporting/multi-currency)
notes: Added Phase 1 — APP layer above M-06 narrow export lib
problem_en: Beyond stablecoin export, companies need full accounting + reporting on-chain (P&L, balance sheet, audit trails, multi-currency). A platform consolidating XRPL on-chain activity into standard accounting reports.
problem_fr: Au-delà de l'export stablecoin, les entreprises ont besoin de comptabilité + reporting complet on-chain (P&L, bilan, audit trail, multi-devise). Une plateforme consolidant l'activité XRPL on-chain en rapports comptables standards.

title: Streaming payroll for DAOs and freelancers
description: Streaming payroll on XRPL — new concept (PayrollXRP blueprint)
notes: Added Phase 1 — new concept not covered elsewhere
problem_en: Monthly batch payroll doesn't fit modern work (DAOs, gig workers, global freelancers). Continuous stream payments make sense but no XRPL service exists. XRPL near-zero fees + fast finality = perfect substrate.
problem_fr: La paie mensuelle en batch ne correspond plus au travail moderne (DAOs, gig workers, freelances globaux). Les paiements en flux continu ont du sens mais aucun service XRPL n'existe. XRPL frais quasi-nuls + finalité rapide = substrat parfait.

title: Regional POS / merchant tooling
description: Retail merchants in emerging markets + EU/MiCA
notes: Vertical illustration: MerchantPay blueprint
problem_en: Emerging markets merchants (Africa, LATAM) want crypto payment terminals. Existing solutions don't support XRPL. Regional POS with EU/MiCA compliance opens 100M+ underbanked users.
problem_fr: Les marchands des marchés émergents (Afrique, LATAM) veulent des terminaux de paiement crypto. Les solutions existantes ne supportent pas XRPL. Un POS régional avec conformité EU/MiCA ouvre 100M+ d'utilisateurs sous-bancarisés.

title: B2B Stablecoin FX desk / corridor (multi-stable routing)
description: Treasury mgmt + API-first FX corridor for fintechs — XRPL native DEX routes multi-hop stablecoin FX with XRP auto-bridge
notes: Florence: RLUSD+USDC+XSGD+EURØP all live · $1B+ monthly stablecoin volume already · B2B layer missing
problem_en: RLUSD, USDC, XSGD, EURØP are all live on XRPL. The native DEX can route multi-hop FX with XRP as auto-bridge. But the B2B-facing layer is missing: no FX desk, no treasury management tool, no API-first corridor for fintechs. This product would generate real DEX volume and slot into institutional stablecoin demand. Volume potential: high — stablecoin monthly volume already $1B+. (Source: Florence interview, May 2026)
problem_fr: RLUSD, USDC, XSGD, EURØP sont tous live sur XRPL. Le DEX natif peut router du FX multi-hop avec XRP en auto-bridge. Mais la couche B2B manque : pas de FX desk, pas d'outil treasury, pas de corridor API-first pour fintechs. Ce produit générerait du vrai volume DEX et adresserait la demande stablecoin institutionnelle. Potentiel volume : élevé — volume mensuel stablecoin déjà $1B+. (Source : interview Florence, mai 2026)

title: Monitoring & B2B alerting
description: XRPL's Tenderly — B2B alerting product with UI
notes: Type changed BLOCK→APP (Tenderly-style product). S-06 is the AI-service variant
problem_en: XRPL has no Tenderly/Forta-equivalent. B2B teams running production XRPL ops are blind to issues until customers complain. Reactive support, not proactive alerting.
problem_fr: XRPL n'a pas d'équivalent Tenderly/Forta. Les équipes B2B en prod XRPL sont aveugles aux incidents jusqu'à ce que les clients se plaignent. Support réactif, pas d'alerting proactif.

title: XRPL-native dApp analytics platform (DappRadar + Dune)
description: DappRadar-style rankings + Dune-style custom dashboards for XRPL native — ecosystem visibility unblock
notes: Added from Xavier interview May 2026 — DappRadar + Dune combined vision, XRPL-native analytics gap
problem_en: XRPL ecosystem participants (builders, analysts, retail) can't easily compare dApps, track TVL/volume/users across XRPL, or build custom dashboards on XRPL data. DappRadar covers EVM chains but XRPL is under-served. Dune doesn't index XRPL natively. Builders auditing competitive landscape and retail discovering dApps both lack a canonical reference. (Source: Xavier interview, May 2026)
problem_fr: Les participants de l'écosystème XRPL (builders, analystes, retail) ne peuvent pas comparer facilement les dApps, suivre TVL/volume/users sur XRPL, ni construire des dashboards custom sur la donnée XRPL. DappRadar couvre les chaînes EVM mais XRPL est sous-servi. Dune n'indexe pas XRPL nativement. Les builders qui auditent leur paysage concurrentiel et le retail qui découvre les dApps manquent tous d'une référence canonique. (Source : interview Xavier, mai 2026)

title: Physical-to-Digital Binding (EU DPP)
description: Regulatory deadline — 12-month EU DPP window
problem_en: EU Digital Product Passport regulation requires every product to have a digital twin by 2027. No XRPL-native binding pattern exists despite XRPL's NFT primitives being ideal. 12-month regulatory window.
problem_fr: La réglementation EU Digital Product Passport exige un jumeau numérique pour chaque produit d'ici 2027. Aucun pattern de binding XRPL natif n'existe alors que les primitives NFT XRPL sont idéales. Fenêtre réglementaire de 12 mois.

title: Yield-Bearing Stablecoin (T-bill backed)
description: USDe parallel — top community demand
problem_en: Users want stablecoin yield without DeFi risk. USDe (Ethena) raised $4B+ proving demand. No XRPL equivalent despite RLUSD being live and T-bill backing being trivially implementable.
problem_fr: Les utilisateurs veulent du yield stablecoin sans risque DeFi. USDe (Ethena) a levé 4Md$+, prouvant la demande. Aucun équivalent XRPL alors que RLUSD est live et qu'un backing T-bill est trivialement implémentable.

title: RWA Issuance Studio EU/MiCA
description: MPT + DID + cap table — A1 Tier 1 #2
notes: Vertical illustrations: PropTok (real estate) in builder-atlas · Florence: MPT-native angle, no-code/low-code platform, mid-market positioning (Archax/abrdn playbook for mid-market)
problem_en: Tokenizing RWA in EU requires MiCA-compliant issuance (MPT + DID + cap table). No XRPL studio offers turnkey EU-compliant tokenization — each issuer rebuilds the legal/tech stack.
problem_fr: Tokeniser un RWA en Europe exige une émission MiCA-conforme (MPT + DID + cap table). Aucun studio XRPL n'offre une tokenisation EU clé en main — chaque émetteur reconstruit la stack juridico-technique.

title: Mid-market corporate bonds
description: On-chain mid-market corporate bond marketplace (BondBloc blueprint)
notes: Added Phase 1 — matches BondBloc blueprint
problem_en: Mid-market companies ($10M–$500M revenue) can't easily issue corporate bonds. Investment banks won't touch sub-$100M issuances. On-chain bond issuance with MiCA compliance opens a $T market.
problem_fr: Les entreprises mid-market (10M$–500M$ de CA) ne peuvent pas émettre facilement de corporate bonds. Les banques d'investissement ne touchent pas aux émissions <100M$. Une émission on-chain avec conformité MiCA ouvre un marché à 1000Md$.

title: RWA structuring firm (AI service)
description: AI agent + lawyer-on-tap that structures RWA tokenization for clients
notes: Added Phase 1 — service company distinct from M-16b (product/studio)
problem_en: Tokenizing RWAs (real estate, bonds, art) requires legal structuring, SPVs, custody. An AI agent + lawyer-on-tap service can handle structuring at 80-90% margin vs traditional Big Law $500/hr.
problem_fr: Tokeniser des RWA (immobilier, obligations, art) exige structuration juridique, SPVs, custody. Un service agent IA + avocat-on-tap peut livrer cette structuration à 80–90% de marge vs 500$/h en Big Law traditionnel.

title: Compliance-native consumer payments app (Wise-on-XRPL)
description: Merchant checkout + recurring billing + cross-border remittance combining Credentials + Permissioned Domains + RLUSD — institutional compliance with consumer UX
notes: Florence: Wise competitor on XRPL · KYC on-chain · sub-cent fees · 3s settlement · $50B+ corridors SEA/LATAM
problem_en: Credentials + Permissioned Domains + RLUSD = a compliant consumer payment rail no other chain can match today. Florence: build merchant checkout, subscription billing, or cross-border remittance app where KYC is on-chain, fees are sub-cent, settlement is 3 seconds. Positioning: 'stablecoin payments with institutional-grade compliance, consumer UX' — Wise competitor built natively on XRPL. Addressable: $50B+ annual remittance corridors (SEA, LATAM). (Source: Florence interview)
problem_fr: Credentials + Permissioned Domains + RLUSD = un rail de paiement consumer conforme qu'aucune autre chaîne ne peut égaler aujourd'hui. Florence : construire merchant checkout, billing récurrent ou app de remittance cross-border où le KYC est on-chain, fees sub-cent, settlement 3s. Positionnement : « paiements stablecoin avec conformité institutionnelle, UX consumer » — concurrent Wise natif XRPL. Addressable : $50B+ corridors annuels SEA/LATAM. (Source : interview Florence)

title: POAP / Event Attendance NFT app (XRPL-native)
description: Proof-of-attendance NFT framework — events, conferences, programs issue attendance NFTs that attendees collect
notes: Added from Florian interview May 2026 — POAP-on-XRPL. Adjacent to OPP-046 (gaming NFT) and Florence's OPP-025 (dNFT tickets/credentials) if Florence integrated
problem_en: POAP (Proof of Attendance Protocol) on Ethereum has tens of thousands of events issuing attendance NFTs. XRPL has no equivalent despite native NFT primitives. Florian: 'les preuves de venue, les POAPs, ce genre de trucs ça manque, on a tout le temps besoin de ça'. Ecosystem events, conferences, training programs all need this primitive. (Source: Florian interview)
problem_fr: POAP (Proof of Attendance Protocol) sur Ethereum a des dizaines de milliers d'événements qui émettent des NFT d'attendance. XRPL n'a pas d'équivalent malgré ses primitives NFT natives. Florian : « les preuves de venue, les POAPs, ce genre de trucs ça manque, on a tout le temps besoin de ça ». Les events écosystème, conférences, programmes de training en ont tous besoin. (Source : interview Florian)

title: Dynamic NFT framework for tickets / credentials / loyalty
description: Framework leveraging dNFT (URI-updatable post-mint, live June 2025) for event ticketing, professional credentials, loyalty passes — native DEX = free secondary market liquidity
notes: Florence: dNFT live June 2025 · resales generate DEX volume directly · adjacent to OPP-026 (POAP) and OPP-046 (gaming NFT)
problem_en: Dynamic NFT (dNFT) went live June 2025 on XRPL. Unlike static NFTs, dNFTs can update URI post-mint — meaning the asset evolves over time. Florence: build event ticketing (seat upgrades, resale control), professional credential badges, or loyalty passes that update in real time. XRPL's native DEX means secondary market liquidity is free. Low fees = mass-market ticket volumes viable. Resales generate DEX volume directly. (Source: Florence interview)
problem_fr: Dynamic NFT (dNFT) est live depuis juin 2025 sur XRPL. Contrairement aux NFT statiques, les dNFT peuvent update l'URI post-mint — l'asset évolue dans le temps. Florence : construire ticketing événementiel (upgrades de sièges, contrôle resale), badges professionnels ou loyalty passes qui s'actualisent en temps réel. Le DEX natif XRPL = liquidité secondaire gratuite. Frais faibles = volumes mass-market viables. Resales = volume DEX direct. (Source : interview Florence)

title: Vault Wrapper Pattern Library (XLS-65)
description: Timing arbitrage on XLS-65 amendment
problem_en: XLS-65 (Single-Asset Vault) is fresh from XRPL amendment process. Building on it requires understanding low-level vault mechanics. A wrapper library would let any builder ship vault products in days, not months.
problem_fr: XLS-65 (Single-Asset Vault) sort tout juste du processus d'amendement XRPL. Construire dessus exige de comprendre la mécanique vault bas niveau. Une librairie wrapper permettrait à n'importe quel builder de livrer un produit vault en jours plutôt qu'en mois.

title: Risk-Signal Aggregation from MPT Trading
description: Kennedy Reassurance — XRPL-native novel pattern
problem_en: MPT trading data contains valuable risk signals (Kennedy reassurance pattern, position dynamics). No aggregator extracts these signals, leaving them invisible to risk managers and lending protocols.
problem_fr: La donnée de trading MPT contient des signaux de risque précieux (pattern Kennedy reassurance, dynamique des positions). Aucun agrégateur n'en extrait ces signaux, qui restent invisibles aux risk managers et protocoles de lending.

title: Lending Protocol on EVM Sidechain (Morpho-style)
description: Morpho-style lending — top community survey need
problem_en: Community survey ranks lending as #1 demanded primitive. EVM Sidechain has no Morpho/Aave-class lending. Without it, sophisticated DeFi capital can't flow into XRPL.
problem_fr: L'enquête communautaire classe le lending comme la primitive #1 demandée. L'EVM Sidechain n'a pas de lending de classe Morpho/Aave. Sans cela, le capital DeFi sophistiqué ne peut pas affluer vers XRPL.

title: Uncollateralized Lending Interface (XLS-66)
description: UI for XLS-66 unsecured lending — Evernorth intent
notes: Merged with gap-08 (Lending senior tranches XLS-66)
problem_en: XLS-66 enables uncollateralized credit on XRPL. Evernorth announced intent but no interface exists. Borrowers and lenders have no way to interact without raw transaction crafting.
problem_fr: XLS-66 permet le crédit non-collatéralisé sur XRPL. Evernorth a annoncé son intention mais aucune interface n'existe. Emprunteurs et prêteurs n'ont aucun moyen d'interagir sans manipuler des transactions brutes.

title: Compliant Credit Vault (institutional service)
description: Agent-curator with attestations — A1 Tier 1 #1
problem_en: Institutional lenders need credit vaults with attestation-based curation (KYC'd borrowers, jurisdiction checks). No XRPL product offers this — institutional capital sits idle.
problem_fr: Les prêteurs institutionnels ont besoin de credit vaults avec curation basée sur attestations (emprunteurs KYC, vérifications juridictionnelles). Aucun produit XRPL ne l'offre — le capital institutionnel reste inactif.

title: Native yield aggregator (Yearn-XRPL)
description: Cross-protocol yield routing for XRPL natively
problem_en: XRPL yield is fragmented across AMM, lending, vaults. Users juggle multiple protocols to find best yield. A Yearn-equivalent aggregator would auto-route capital, improving UX and yields.
problem_fr: Le yield XRPL est fragmenté entre AMM, lending, vaults. Les users jonglent entre plusieurs protocoles pour trouver le meilleur rendement. Un agrégateur équivalent Yearn routerait automatiquement le capital, améliorant UX et rendements.

title: Lending front-end on Single Asset Vault (pre-XLS-66)
description: UX layer NOW on XLS-65 Vault (live) — lend/borrow UI + yield dashboard + institutional credit desk — flip-switch when XLS-66 passes
notes: Florence: timing arbitrage — XLS-66 not yet live but XLS-65 IS · first-mover positioning · $50M+ institutional flow
problem_en: The Lending Protocol amendment (XLS-66) is not yet live, but Single Asset Vault (XLS-65) IS live. Florence: builders shouldn't wait for the amendment — they should ship the UX layer NOW on top of XLS-65 (lend/borrow interface, yield dashboard, institutional credit desk) so that when XLS-66 passes, they flip a switch. Judges reward 'lending-ready' architecture, not waiting for the amendment. Targets: market makers, PSPs, fintechs. First-mover on a $50M+ institutional lending flow. (Source: Florence interview)
problem_fr: L'amendement Lending Protocol (XLS-66) n'est pas encore live, mais Single Asset Vault (XLS-65) l'est. Florence : les builders ne devraient pas attendre l'amendement — ils devraient livrer la couche UX MAINTENANT sur XLS-65 (interface lend/borrow, yield dashboard, credit desk institutionnel) pour flip-switcher quand XLS-66 passe. Les juges récompensent l'architecture « lending-ready », pas l'attente de l'amendement. Cibles : market makers, PSPs, fintechs. First-mover sur $50M+ de flux lending institutionnels. (Source : interview Florence)

title: Non-USD Stablecoin DeFi Rails
description: EUR/BRL/SGD/AUD rails
problem_en: Most XRPL DeFi assumes USD. EUR/BRL/SGD/AUD stablecoins exist but lack rails to integrate into lending, AMMs, vaults — locking out non-US users from native-currency DeFi.
problem_fr: La DeFi XRPL part du principe que tout est en USD. Les stablecoins EUR/BRL/SGD/AUD existent mais manquent de rails pour s'intégrer dans le lending, les AMMs, les vaults — excluant les users non-US de la DeFi en devise locale.

title: Restaking Protocol for XRP (Babylon-fork)
description: $110B+ XRP cap underutilized
problem_en: $110B+ XRP market cap sits idle. Babylon proved restaking is a major DeFi primitive. XRPL has no equivalent — capital can't be productively re-deployed beyond staking/holding.
problem_fr: 110Md$+ de market cap XRP restent inactifs. Babylon a prouvé que le restaking est une primitive DeFi majeure. XRPL n'a pas d'équivalent — le capital ne peut pas être redéployé productivement au-delà du staking/hold.

title: Synthetic Assets / CDP Protocol (× Axiom)
description: Gold/stocks/forex synthetic assets
problem_en: Users want exposure to gold, stocks, forex on-chain. Synthetix/Axiom proved demand. EVM Sidechain has no synthetic-asset protocol — users go to Ethereum and bridge back.
problem_fr: Les users veulent une exposition à l'or, aux actions, au forex on-chain. Synthetix/Axiom ont prouvé la demande. L'EVM Sidechain n'a aucun protocole d'actifs synthétiques — les users vont sur Ethereum puis bridgent.

title: Perpetual DEX (vAMM or order book)
description: Derivatives = highest volume DeFi — XRPL at zero
problem_en: Derivatives = highest-volume DeFi category globally. XRPL has zero perpetual DEXs. Traders go to Hyperliquid/dYdX. Without perps, XRPL DeFi will plateau at spot only.
problem_fr: Les dérivés = catégorie DeFi à plus gros volume globalement. XRPL a zéro DEX perpétuel. Les traders vont sur Hyperliquid/dYdX. Sans perps, la DeFi XRPL plafonnera au spot uniquement.

title: Decentralized Insurance Protocol
description: Maturity signal for institutional adoption
notes: Distinct from S-08 (AI underwriting service that can feed it)
problem_en: Institutional DeFi adoption requires insurance against smart contract risk. Nexus Mutual/InsurAce serve Ethereum but no XRPL equivalent. Institutional capital won't allocate without insurance.
problem_fr: L'adoption DeFi institutionnelle exige une assurance contre le risque smart contract. Nexus Mutual/InsurAce servent Ethereum mais aucun équivalent XRPL. Le capital institutionnel n'allouera pas sans assurance.

title: Prediction markets infrastructure
description: Engine layer · Polymarket equivalent
problem_en: Polymarket made $3B+ on US elections alone. The infrastructure for prediction markets (oracle resolution, market creation, settlement) is missing on XRPL/EVM Sidechain.
problem_fr: Polymarket a fait 3Md$+ rien que sur les élections US. L'infrastructure de prediction markets (résolution oracle, création de marché, settlement) est absente sur XRPL/EVM Sidechain.

title: Prediction markets dApps (consumer)
description: Polymarket-style for politics/sports/crypto
problem_en: Once infrastructure exists, consumer-facing prediction dApps (politics, sports, crypto events) are the user-facing product. Polymarket-style UX on XRPL captures share Polymarket can't reach.
problem_fr: Une fois l'infrastructure en place, les dApps consumer de prediction markets (politique, sport, événements crypto) sont le produit user-facing. Une UX Polymarket-style sur XRPL capte des parts de marché que Polymarket ne peut pas atteindre.

title: DeFi underwriting / insurance (AI service)
description: AI agent prices DeFi risk and underwrites for insurance protocols
notes: Added Phase 1 — service distinct from M-20 (insurance protocol)
problem_en: DeFi insurance protocols need underwriting expertise to price risk. AI agents trained on historical exploit data can underwrite programmatically at 70-90% margin vs human actuaries.
problem_fr: Les protocoles d'assurance DeFi ont besoin d'expertise de souscription pour pricer le risque. Des agents IA entraînés sur la donnée historique d'exploits peuvent souscrire programmatiquement à 70–90% de marge vs les actuaires humains.

title: Liquid Staked XRP (LST · Lido-equivalent for XRP)
description: Stake XRP → receive liquid stXRP token that accrues yield + remains composable in DeFi (lending collateral, AMM LP, vault inputs)
notes: Added from Guillaume CeDeFi Yield research follow-up (May 14, 2026) — most critical missing DeFi primitive. Lido stETH ~$30B TVL, Jito jitoSOL/Marinade mSOL ~$5B each. Unlocks all downstream composability (lending against staked XRP, LP yield-bearing positions, restaking).
problem_en: $110B+ XRP market cap sits idle waiting for productive yield. Ethereum solved this with Lido (~$30B TVL stETH), Solana with Jito/Marinade (~$5B each). XRPL has no Liquid Staking Token — the most fundamental DeFi primitive for retail. Without LST, all downstream DeFi composability (lending against staked XRP, LP'ing yield-bearing positions, restaking) is blocked. (Source: Guillaume interview follow-up, May 2026 — XRPL CeDeFi Yield gap research)
problem_fr: Plus de 110Md$ de XRP market cap restent inactifs en attente d'un yield productif. Ethereum a résolu ça avec Lido (~30Md$ TVL stETH), Solana avec Jito/Marinade (~5Md$ chacun). XRPL n'a aucun Liquid Staking Token — la primitive DeFi la plus fondamentale pour le retail. Sans LST, toute la composabilité DeFi downstream (lending contre XRP staké, LP de positions yield-bearing, restaking) est bloquée. (Source : interview Guillaume follow-up, mai 2026 — recherche CeDeFi Yield gap XRPL)

title: Yield tokenization platform (Pendle-style PT/YT split)
description: Split yield-bearing assets (RLUSD-yield, stXRP, XLS-65 vault tokens) into Principal Tokens + Yield Tokens — Pendle equivalent on XRPL
notes: Added from Guillaume CeDeFi Yield research follow-up (May 14, 2026) — next-layer DeFi primitive. Pendle $5B TVL on Ethereum. Dependency: requires OPP-033 (yield stablecoin) + OPP-043 (LST XRP) + OPP-028 (XLS-65 vault wrapper) to be useful.
problem_en: Yield tokenization (Pendle on Ethereum, $5B TVL) lets users separate principal from yield, creating a secondary market for future yield rates. XRPL has no equivalent. As yield-bearing assets emerge on XRPL (T-bill stablecoins, stXRP LST, single-asset vaults), the next-layer DeFi primitive is yield-tokenization PT/YT split. Dependency: requires OPP-033 yield stablecoin + OPP-043 LST + OPP-028 XLS-65 vault wrapper to be useful. (Source: Guillaume interview follow-up, May 2026 — XRPL CeDeFi Yield gap research)
problem_fr: La tokenisation de yield (Pendle sur Ethereum, 5Md$ TVL) permet de séparer principal et yield, créant un marché secondaire sur le rendement futur. XRPL n'a pas d'équivalent. À mesure que les actifs yield-bearing émergent sur XRPL (stablecoins T-bill, stXRP LST, single-asset vaults), la primitive DeFi de prochain niveau est la tokenisation PT/YT du yield. Dépendance : nécessite OPP-033 yield stablecoin + OPP-043 LST + OPP-028 XLS-65 vault wrapper pour avoir du sens. (Source : interview Guillaume follow-up, mai 2026 — recherche CeDeFi Yield gap XRPL)

title: Chunked Data + On-Chain Anchoring Pattern
description: IPFS/S3/self-hosted with on-chain anchoring
problem_en: Large data (legal docs, media files) can't fit on XRPL. Builders piecemeal-solve with IPFS/S3 + manual anchoring. A standard pattern would unify the approach and unlock data-heavy use cases.
problem_fr: Les données volumineuses (documents juridiques, fichiers média) ne tiennent pas sur XRPL. Les builders bricolent avec IPFS/S3 + ancrage manuel. Un pattern standard unifierait l'approche et débloquerait les cas d'usage data-heavy.

title: Gaming utility-NFT framework
description: Play-to-earn + asset interop — XRPL NFT primitives
problem_en: Game devs need NFT primitives for play-to-earn (items, achievements, cross-game assets). XRPL has NFT support but no game-specific framework — devs build from scratch every time.
problem_fr: Les game devs ont besoin de primitives NFT pour le play-to-earn (items, achievements, assets cross-game). XRPL supporte les NFT mais aucun framework spécifique aux jeux — les devs reconstruisent à chaque fois.

title: Pre-Deployed Testnet Infrastructure
description: Multiplier across everything — sandbox · SurfPool-equivalent (Solana parallel)
problem_en: Builders waste weeks setting up testnet environments, deploying canonical contracts, seeding test data. Devs also lack a SurfPool-equivalent local node (XRPL forces shared testnet — slow, flaky, replay-unfriendly). Solana has SurfPool, Ethereum has Anvil/Hardhat; XRPL is a productivity outlier. A pre-deployed sandbox + local node combo would multiply velocity across the entire ecosystem. (Confirmed in Djason interview, May 2026)
problem_fr: Les builders perdent des semaines à monter leur environnement testnet, déployer les contrats canoniques, seeder la donnée de test. Les devs manquent aussi d'un équivalent SurfPool en node local (XRPL force le testnet partagé — lent, instable, peu replay-friendly). Solana a SurfPool, Ethereum a Anvil/Hardhat ; XRPL est un outlier productivité. Une sandbox pré-déployée + combo node local multiplierait la vélocité de tout l'écosystème. (Confirmé en interview Djason, mai 2026)

title: Vendor-Neutral Oracle / Bridge / Ramp Adapters
description: Zero-code-change provider swap (lib for app builders)
notes: Distinct from gap-12 (data marketplace for buyers)
problem_en: Switching from one oracle (Pyth) to another (Chronicle) requires code rewrites. Same for bridges and fiat ramps. Vendor-neutral adapters would let builders swap providers without code change.
problem_fr: Passer d'un oracle (Pyth) à un autre (Chronicle) exige des réécritures de code. Idem pour bridges et fiat ramps. Des adaptateurs vendor-neutral permettraient aux builders de swap leurs providers sans changement de code.

title: CeDeFi Yield Integration SDK (CEX channel)
description: 60%+ XRP on CEX — #1 distribution play
problem_en: 60%+ of XRP sits on centralized exchanges (Binance, Bybit, Coinbase). DeFi yield is locked away from this majority. An SDK letting CEXs route XRP into XRPL DeFi = #1 distribution play.
problem_fr: 60%+ du XRP est sur les CEX (Binance, Bybit, Coinbase). Le yield DeFi est inaccessible à cette majorité. Un SDK permettant aux CEX de router du XRP vers la DeFi XRPL = #1 play distribution.

title: P-256 / secp256r1 Signing (XLS proposal)
description: Cross-cutting — Apple Secure Enclave + WebAuthn + HSM
problem_en: Apple Secure Enclave + WebAuthn + most HSMs use P-256 keys. XRPL only supports secp256k1 and ed25519 — blocking Apple-device-native signing and enterprise HSM integration.
problem_fr: Apple Secure Enclave + WebAuthn + la plupart des HSM utilisent des clés P-256. XRPL ne supporte que secp256k1 et ed25519 — bloquant le signing natif Apple et l'intégration HSM entreprise.

title: Data marketplace · oracle aggregator
description: Multi-source oracle aggregator + data marketplace for data buyers
notes: Added Phase 1 — distinct from M-23 (vendor-neutral adapters)
problem_en: Data buyers (devs, traders) need access to varied feeds (price, weather, sports, custom). No XRPL marketplace exists where data sellers and buyers meet. Devs are stuck with one oracle and a contract.
problem_fr: Les data buyers (devs, traders) ont besoin d'accès à des feeds variés (prix, météo, sport, custom). Aucune marketplace XRPL n'existe où sellers et buyers de data se rencontrent. Les devs sont coincés avec un seul oracle sous contrat.

title: DEX + AMM liquidity aggregator / market-making SDK
description: SDK routing orders across native DEX (order book) AND AMM with slippage optimization + market-making API — pre-requisite for institutional MM at scale
notes: Florence: pure infrastructure · volume IS the product · enables $50M day-1 target · institutional MM dependency
problem_en: XRPL has a native DEX (order book) AND an AMM. No mainstream aggregator bridges both. Florence: build an SDK or service that routes orders across both, with slippage optimization and a market-making API. Institutional market makers (main borrowers under the lending protocol) need this before they go on-chain at scale. Pure infrastructure, direct volume impact — enables the $50M volume target from day 1 — volume IS the product. (Source: Florence interview)
problem_fr: XRPL a un DEX natif (order book) ET un AMM. Aucun aggregator mainstream ne route entre les deux. Florence : construire un SDK ou service qui route les ordres sur les deux avec optimisation slippage + API market-making. Les market makers institutionnels (principaux emprunteurs sous le lending protocol) en ont besoin avant de scale on-chain. Infrastructure pure, impact volume direct — permet d'atteindre le target $50M dès day 1 — le volume EST le produit. (Source : interview Florence)

title: XRPL Transaction Indexer (TheGraph-equivalent)
description: Backend indexer for XRPL transactions — TheGraph-like infra layer that powers analytics, dashboards, and dApp data queries
notes: Added from Guillaume interview May 2026 — backend infra (distinct from OPP-019 Xavier dApp analytics which is the front-end product). The Graph parallel for XRPL.
problem_en: Building any analytics, dashboard, or data-heavy XRPL app today requires running your own indexer from scratch (parsing ledgers, building data layers, exposing GraphQL/REST). No mainstream TheGraph-equivalent exists for XRPL. Every builder rebuilds the same indexing infrastructure. Blocks the dApp data layer ecosystem. (Source: Guillaume interview, May 2026)
problem_fr: Construire toute analytics, dashboard ou app XRPL data-heavy aujourd'hui exige de faire tourner son propre indexer de zéro (parsing ledgers, couches data, exposition GraphQL/REST). Aucun équivalent The Graph mainstream sur XRPL. Chaque builder reconstruit la même infra d'indexation. Bloque l'écosystème data-layer dApps. (Source : interview Guillaume, mai 2026)

title: Pluggable Proof Primitives Library
description: Hash/signature/ZK/BYO-scheme — composable primitives
problem_en: Different use cases need different proof schemes (hash, signature, ZK). No XRPL library provides a pluggable framework, forcing each project to pick one and reimplement from scratch.
problem_fr: Différents cas d'usage exigent différents schémas de preuve (hash, signature, ZK). Aucune librairie XRPL ne fournit un framework pluggable, forçant chaque projet à choisir un schéma et tout réimplémenter de zéro.

title: Proof of Humanity / KYA-NFT primitive (XRPL-native)
description: On-chain human verification NFT + score — Gitcoin Passport / Worldcoin equivalent native to XRPL
notes: Added from Florian interview May 2026 — distinct from OPP-006 (reuse layer) ; this is the primitive (NFT + score)
problem_en: No XRPL primitive lets you flag an account as operated by a verified human. Florian: 'on Ethereum you have tons of stuff to prove you're human, score systems, NFT certificates — it doesn't exist on XRPL'. Without this primitive, every XRPL app rebuilds its own KYC + bot-defense from scratch. Gitcoin Passport / Worldcoin parallel. (Source: Florian interview, May 2026)
problem_fr: Aucune primitive XRPL ne permet de flagger un compte comme opéré par un humain vérifié. Florian : « sur Ethereum tu as plein de trucs pour prouver que tu es humain, des systèmes de score, NFT certificats — ça existe pas sur XRP ». Sans cette primitive, chaque app XRPL reconstruit son propre KYC + défense anti-bot de zéro. Parallèle Gitcoin Passport / Worldcoin. (Source : interview Florian, mai 2026)

title: AgentPay — x402 + XRPL settlement
description: AI agent payments facilitator — programmatic infra
notes: Merged with gap-07 + AgentPay blueprint
problem_en: AI agents need to make payments. x402 (Cloudflare) is the emerging payment protocol but lacks XRPL settlement. AgentPay would bridge x402 + XRPL near-zero fees, capturing agent economy spend.
problem_fr: Les agents IA ont besoin de faire des paiements. x402 (Cloudflare) est le protocole de paiement émergent mais sans settlement XRPL. AgentPay ferait le pont x402 + frais quasi-nuls XRPL, capturant la dépense de l'économie agent.

title: AI-Native Compliance Ops (service company)
description: YC RFS lens — also Service-01
notes: Merged with service-01
problem_en: Compliance is expensive (lawyers, KYC vendors, manual reviews). YC RFS thesis: an AI agent + lawyer-on-tap can deliver compliance-as-a-service at 70-90% margin. No XRPL-native compliance service exists.
problem_fr: La compliance coûte cher (avocats, vendors KYC, revues manuelles). Thèse YC RFS : un agent IA + avocat-on-tap peut délivrer du compliance-as-a-service à 70–90% de marge. Aucun service de compliance XRPL natif n'existe.

title: AI-Native Treasury Ops (RLUSD automation)
description: A1 service-thesis — also Service-02 Treasury-aaS
notes: Merged with service-02
problem_en: Treasuries on XRPL need automated RLUSD management (rebalancing, yield optimization, payments scheduling). No AI-native treasury service exists despite XRPL's multisig+RegularKey being ideal for agent-controlled treasury.
problem_fr: Les treasuries sur XRPL ont besoin d'automatisation RLUSD (rebalancing, optimisation yield, paiements programmés). Aucun service treasury AI-native n'existe alors que XRPL multisig + RegularKey est idéal pour un treasury contrôlé par agent.

title: AI-Native Restaking Manager (yield optimizer)
description: A1 service-thesis · auto-rebalance
problem_en: Restaking yield optimization requires constant rebalancing across protocols. Humans can't do this manually. An AI service that auto-rebalances would extract maximum yield with minimal user effort.
problem_fr: L'optimisation de yield restaking exige un rebalancing constant entre protocoles. Les humains ne peuvent pas le faire manuellement. Un service IA qui rebalance automatiquement extrairait un yield maximal avec un effort utilisateur minimal.

title: Onchain Reputation for AI Agents (KYA)
description: A1 service-thesis · agent identity layer
problem_en: As AI agents proliferate, counterparties need to verify agent identity and history (KYA = Know Your Agent). No XRPL reputation primitive exists — agents can't build verifiable track records.
problem_fr: Alors que les agents IA prolifèrent, les contreparties ont besoin de vérifier identité et historique d'un agent (KYA = Know Your Agent). Aucune primitive de réputation XRPL n'existe — les agents ne peuvent pas construire un track record vérifiable.

title: Market-making-as-a-Service
description: AI agent provides liquidity · 70-90% margin
problem_en: New tokens lack liquidity at launch. Manual market-making is expensive (specialists). AI agents can provide liquidity programmatically with 70-90% margin vs traditional MMs' 30-40%.
problem_fr: Les nouveaux tokens manquent de liquidité au lancement. Le market-making manuel coûte cher (spécialistes). Des agents IA peuvent fournir de la liquidité programmatiquement à 70–90% de marge vs 30–40% pour les MMs traditionnels.

title: Community-ops-as-a-Service
description: AI agent runs Discord + Twitter + grants ops
problem_en: Crypto projects need 24/7 community management (Discord, grants, Twitter). Humans cost $80k+/year. An AI agent service delivers 24/7 at fraction of cost.
problem_fr: Les projets crypto ont besoin de community management 24/7 (Discord, grants, Twitter). Un humain coûte 80k$+/an. Un service agent IA délivre du 24/7 à une fraction du coût.

title: Dispute resolution & recovery
description: AI agent handles claims · refunds · recovery
problem_en: Crypto transactions are irreversible — but disputes still happen (mistaken sends, scams, malicious actors). No service handles claims, refunds, and recovery on-chain. Lost funds = lost users.
problem_fr: Les transactions crypto sont irréversibles — mais les disputes arrivent quand même (envois par erreur, scams, acteurs malveillants). Aucun service ne gère claims, refunds, recovery on-chain. Fonds perdus = users perdus.

title: AI trading agents (DCA · momentum · alpha)
description: Quant agents on XRPL · alpha generation
problem_en: Retail traders want algorithmic strategies but can't write them. AI trading agents on XRPL — pre-built (DCA, momentum) or custom (alpha) — democratize sophisticated trading.
problem_fr: Les retail traders veulent des stratégies algorithmiques mais ne peuvent pas les coder. Des agents IA de trading sur XRPL — préfabriqués (DCA, momentum) ou custom (alpha) — démocratisent le trading sophistiqué.

title: Agent treasury + wallet for AI
description: Wallet/treasury infrastructure for AI agents — 3rd layer of agent stack (with M-26 payments + M-30 identity)
notes: Added Phase 1 — distinct from M-26 (payments) and M-30 (identity)
problem_en: AI agents need a wallet they control programmatically with proper guardrails (spending limits, multisig overrides, audit logs). No XRPL-native agent wallet exists despite XRPL's multisig + RegularKey being ideal.
problem_fr: Les agents IA ont besoin d'un wallet qu'ils contrôlent programmatiquement avec les bons garde-fous (spending limits, override multisig, audit logs). Aucun wallet agent XRPL natif n'existe alors que XRPL multisig + RegularKey est idéal.

title: Audit & continuous monitoring (AI service)
description: AI service that continuously audits client protocols
notes: Added Phase 1 — service distinct from G-02 (B2B tooling)
problem_en: Smart contract audits cost $50-200k and are one-shot (state at audit time). Continuous monitoring requires expensive human teams. AI-based continuous audit delivers fresh insights at 80%+ margin.
problem_fr: Les audits de smart contract coûtent 50–200k$ et sont one-shot (état à l'instant T). Le monitoring continu exige des équipes humaines coûteuses. Un audit continu IA délivre des insights frais à 80%+ de marge.

title: AI agent credit card with RLUSD spending
description: Credit-card-like primitive for AI agents to spend RLUSD with guardrails — XRPL equivalent of OpenClaw on Solana
notes: Added from Djason interview — OpenClaw parallel
problem_en: AI agents need a credit-card-like primitive to spend RLUSD with guardrails. Solana has OpenClaw. XRPL has no equivalent despite multisig + RegularKey being ideal for agent-controlled spending. (Source: Djason interview)
problem_fr: Les agents IA ont besoin d'une primitive carte-de-crédit pour dépenser du RLUSD avec garde-fous. Solana a OpenClaw. XRPL n'a pas d'équivalent alors que multisig + RegularKey sont idéaux pour la dépense contrôlée par agent. (Source : interview Djason)
